hidden_states.description: deterministic synthetic BF16 hidden states sampled from N(0, 1)

router.routing: FP32 softmax over all router logits, followed by top-10 selection; selected routed weights are renormalized to sum to one

reference.description: Routed-branch-only FP32 weighted sum of top-10 outputs using the original stored BF16 expert weights; shared_expert and shared_expert_gate are intentionally excluded. Matrix products use FP32 accumulation and each expert rounds the gated intermediate activation to BF16.

oracle_dynamic.description: retrospectively select the candidate with the lowest relative L2 error against the BF16 reference for each hidden state

static_expert_assignment.description: fixed expert-level tiers calibrated from empirical router top-10 selection probability; see the separate assignment file

quantization.description: Q2_K through Q8_K slots use llama.cpp quantize_row_qx_K_ref followed by dequantize_row_qx_K. If present, one-bit slots use llama.cpp IQ1_M via ggml_quantize_chunk followed by dequantize_row_iq1_m. Dequantized matrices are multiplied in FP32 to measure weight-representation error rather than end-to-end llama.cpp kernel error. One selected expert and one matrix are processed at a time.
quantization.iq1_m_importance: per-input weights derived from the measured activation: hidden_state^2 for gate/up and quantized-path intermediate^2 for down
